desc: 天青加象牙浪台棚拍的透明罩盖奶瓶，九屏漏斗式卖点详情
leaf: 梨形瓶身透明圆顶罩盖奶瓶
name: 天青云浪玫粉瓶盖环奶瓶款

shots.intent: 用天青棚色加奶白浪台把整只瓶子的圆顶罩盖与玫粉瓶盖环一次看清，抢首屏停留
shots.textZone: 上部留白带放一条中文主标与一行小字副标，主标后方压一行宽字距拉丁底纹

shots.intent: 把买家选购时的三个疑问做成图章条加三张空白卡，条目全部占位不编造材质与倍数
shots.textZone: 顶部图章条下两行标题位，右侧三张空白卡各带一枚空白标签胶囊

shots.intent: 复刻详情页两栏对照结构但左栏留白给卖家自贴，避免虚构对手品与胜负结论
shots.textZone: 顶部一条对照标题，两栏各一枚空白标签胶囊与一枚空白圆章位

shots.intent: 放进冷光居家案边语境让人代入，成人从肩下取景、婴儿只留背影且全程被托抱
仰视微距交代罩盖、瓶盖环与奶嘴的装配关系，用同一枚圆窗补一个俯视结构
shots.textZone: 圆窗旁一枚空白标签胶囊

shots.intent: 正侧面交代梨形瓶身与收腰曲线，三枚虚线引线把结构条目交给占位符
shots.textZone: 右侧三行空白标签胶囊，顶部一条造型小标题，底部一条宽字距斜杠小字带

shots.intent: 复刻详情页产品档案五档结构，字段名与数值全部留空，杜绝参数与材质杜撰
shots.textZone: 右侧五行档案条目，字段名与数值全部留空占位

shots.intent: 同款三支错落并列撑起货架感，选款圆章留空，配色严格沿用参考图不新造色
shots.textZone: 三支下方各一枚空白圆章位与一条选款小标题

shots.intent: 在同一视觉体系里收口并留出行动位，把加购引导交给不编造事实的占位符
shots.textZone: 下部留白带放结束标题、一枚空白行动按钮与两枚空白圆章位，底部一条宽字距斜杠小字带

style.backgroundSystem: a sky-aqua #6FC8D6 cove band over an ivory #FBF1E4 wave-ridge plateau, plus rounded-corner cards graded from pale aqua #D9EEF1 at the top into shell pink #F6DCE2 at the bottom laid on a pale ivory #FBF1E4 field, with exactly one tangent sphere cluster in pale ivory #FBF1E4 per screen, never a dark, wood or metallic field
style.direction: cool aqua-and-ivory maternal-infant feeding bottle commerce
style.iconSystem: solid filled circular icon chips of one single diameter in amber #F2A93B or rose #E88FA6 with the glyph knocked out in the card colour, mounted inside an amber #F2A93B gradient pill bar, plus dotted-leader callout lines ending in a filled dot; no outline-only icon sets, no second icon weight
style.lightingSystem: crisp cool key light from the upper camera right with a low cool bounce card from the front left, one narrow rim along the shoulder of the clear dome, one defined contact shadow plus a shallow reflection under the base, medium contrast throughout, about 6500K
style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent cool aqua-and-ivory maternal-infant feeding bottle commerce visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of sky-aqua #6FC8D6 and pale ivory #FBF1E4 bases with a shell pink #F6DCE2 secondary field, one amber #F2A93B accent, one rose #E88FA6 chip colour and deep slate-teal text #2C4550; cool daylight tone throughout at about 6500K; background system limited to a sky-aqua #6FC8D6 cove band over an ivory wave-ridge plateau plus rounded-corner cards graded from pale aqua #D9EEF1 above into shell pink #F6DCE2 below on a pale ivory #FBF1E4 field, with exactly one tangent sphere cluster in pale ivory #FBF1E4 per screen and never a dark, wood or metallic field; crisp cool key light from the upper camera right with a low cool bounce from the front left, one narrow rim along the shoulder of the clear dome, one defined contact shadow plus a shallow reflection under the base, medium contrast; one heavy rounded Chinese display family for a single short headline with a wide-tracked pale aqua #D9EEF1 Latin overprint word behind it, one folded amber #F2A93B ribbon flag above it and one letter-spaced slash kicker strip at the base of the screen, one short line of copy only; solid filled circular icon chips of one single diameter in amber #F2A93B or rose #E88FA6 with the glyph knocked out, mounted in an amber gradient pill bar, plus dotted-leader callouts ending in a filled dot; the bottle stays upright at a stable scale on the wave ridge with the clear dome fitted and the collar ring closed, the nipple seated and secured inside the dome, pear-shaped frosted body, wide rose collar ring, original dome height and body taper, any graduation marking kept exactly as shot and any label area left as one blank legible field; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles, no dark scenes, no new product colors, no invented numbers.
noDrift: no 「新生儿」 or 「宝宝专用」 age indication: no month or year range, no newborn wording, no suitability statement about a child
no medical or therapeutic wording: no 「防胀气」 phrasing, no anti-colic, cure, relief or digestion benefit
no doctor, hospital, midwife or laboratory endorsement and no breastfeeding-equivalence claim such as 「像喝母乳一样」
no material-grade claim: no glass, borosilicate, PPSU, PES, silicone grade, food-grade or BPA-free wording
no sterilisation, disinfection or high-temperature standard, no 「可消毒」 phrasing, no temperature or time figures
no certification mark, test report, inspection seal, award, platform badge or registration number
no 「进口」 or imported-origin wording, no country name and no flag artwork
no invented numbers: no 「6倍」 multiple, no percentage, no bar-chart comparison, no capacity, dimension, pack count, shelf life, price, discount, coupon or delivery-time figure
no visible infant face; any child appears only from behind or cropped above the jaw and is always held and supervised by an adult; no bottle at the mouth and never an unattended bottle
no loose or unsecured nipple and no detached or floating parts: the nipple stays seated inside the closed dome
no microwave, no steam or hot liquid touching skin, no water droplets on skin

no brand name, store name, logo, watermark, QR code or 「加入会员」 membership corner; no dark, wood or metallic fields; no mixed fonts, random backgrounds, inconsistent lighting, mismatched icon styles or recoloured product between screens
style.presentationRules: the bottle stands upright at a stable scale on the ivory wave ridge with the clear dome fitted and the collar ring closed, the nipple always seated and secured inside the dome; the pear-shaped frosted body, the wide rose #E88FA6 collar ring, the dome height and the body taper are never redrawn, the neck ring at the dome shoulder keeps its exact reference colour and placement, any graduation or scale marking stays exactly as shot and is never added or removed, and the label area always reads as one blank legible field with no redrawn wording; the product is never occluded by props, never floats without its contact shadow and vertical lines stay vertical
style.surfaceSystem: soft matte ivory #FBF1E4 wave-ridge plateau with a faint meniscus edge, holding a shallow cool reflection and one defined contact shadow under the base, with a tangent sphere cluster in pale ivory #FBF1E4 placed at the foot of the product
style.typography: one heavy rounded Chinese display family for a single short headline in deep slate-teal #2C4550, always carrying a wide-tracked pale aqua #D9EEF1 Latin overprint word behind the headline, one small folded amber #F2A93B ribbon flag above it and one letter-spaced slash kicker strip along the base of the screen; one short line of copy only, no dense body text, no mixed fonts
